import json, os, re, hmac, hashlib, datetime, urllib.parse, urllib.request
from urllib.parse import urlparse

p = _items[0]['json']
slug = p.get('slug', 'a-ham')
source_bucket = p.get('source_bucket', 'mottruyen-refactored')
audio_bucket = p.get('audio_bucket', 'mottruyen-audio')
chunk_chars = int(p.get('chunk_chars', 1500))
ref_audio = (p.get('ref_audio') or '').strip()
ref_text = (p.get('ref_text') or '').strip()
voice_design_json = (p.get('voice_design_json') or '').strip()
seed = int(p.get('seed', 42))

endpoint = os.environ.get('MINIO_ENDPOINT', 'http://minio:9000')
access_key = os.environ['MINIO_ACCESS_KEY']
secret_key = os.environ['MINIO_SECRET_KEY']
region = os.environ.get('MINIO_REGION', 'us-east-1')

def s3_get(bucket, key):
    parsed = urlparse(endpoint); host = parsed.netloc
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC)
    amzdate = now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'); datestamp = now.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    empty_hash = 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
    canonical_uri = '/' + bucket + '/' + urllib.parse.quote(key, safe='/')
    canonical_headers = f'host:{host}\nx-amz-content-sha256:{empty_hash}\nx-amz-date:{amzdate}\n'
    signed_headers = 'host;x-amz-content-sha256;x-amz-date'
    canonical_request = f'GET\n{canonical_uri}\n\n{canonical_headers}\n{signed_headers}\n{empty_hash}'
    credential_scope = f'{datestamp}/{region}/s3/aws4_request'
    string_to_sign = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256\n{amzdate}\n{credential_scope}\n{hashlib.sha256(canonical_request.encode()).hexdigest()}'
    def _sign(k, m): return hmac.new(k, m.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    k_date = _sign(('AWS4' + secret_key).encode(), datestamp)
    k_region = _sign(k_date, region); k_service = _sign(k_region, 's3'); k_signing = _sign(k_service, 'aws4_request')
    signature = hmac.new(k_signing, string_to_sign.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    auth = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential={access_key}/{credential_scope}, SignedHeaders={signed_headers}, Signature={signature}'
    rq = urllib.request.Request(f'{endpoint}{canonical_uri}', headers={'Host': host, 'X-Amz-Date': amzdate, 'X-Amz-Content-SHA256': empty_hash, 'Authorization': auth})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(rq, timeout=120) as resp:
        return resp.read().decode('utf-8')

key = f'{slug}/{slug}_full.txt'
text = s3_get(source_bucket, key)

# Normalize whitespace, then chunk by paragraph then by length
paragraphs = [pp.strip() for pp in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', text) if pp.strip()]

chunks = []
buf = ''
for para in paragraphs:
    if len(buf) + len(para) + 2 <= chunk_chars:
        buf = (buf + '\n\n' + para).strip()
    else:
        if buf: chunks.append(buf)
        # if single paragraph longer than chunk_chars, split by sentence
        if len(para) > chunk_chars:
            sentences = re.split(r'(?<=[\.\!\?\u2026])\s+', para)
            cur = ''
            for s in sentences:
                if len(cur) + len(s) + 1 <= chunk_chars:
                    cur = (cur + ' ' + s).strip()
                else:
                    if cur: chunks.append(cur)
                    cur = s
            if cur: chunks.append(cur)
            buf = ''
        else:
            buf = para
if buf: chunks.append(buf)

try:
    voice_design = json.loads(voice_design_json) if voice_design_json else None
except Exception:
    voice_design = None

if not chunks:
    return [{'json': {'status': 'no_text', 'slug': slug}}]

return [
    {'json': {
        'slug': slug,
        'audio_bucket': audio_bucket,
        'chunk_id': i + 1,
        'total_chunks': len(chunks),
        'text': c,
        'ref_audio': ref_audio or None,
        'ref_text': ref_text or None,
        'voice_design': voice_design,
        'seed': seed + i,
    }} for i, c in enumerate(chunks)
]

import json, os, hmac, hashlib, datetime, urllib.parse, urllib.request
from urllib.parse import urlparse

endpoint = os.environ.get('MINIO_ENDPOINT', 'http://minio:9000')
access_key = os.environ['MINIO_ACCESS_KEY']
secret_key = os.environ['MINIO_SECRET_KEY']
region = os.environ.get('MINIO_REGION', 'us-east-1')

OMNIVOICE_URL = os.environ.get('OMNIVOICE_URL', 'http://omnivoice:8000/tts')

def s3_put(bucket, key, data, content_type='application/octet-stream'):
    parsed = urlparse(endpoint); host = parsed.netloc
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC)
    amzdate = now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'); datestamp = now.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    payload_hash = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    canonical_uri = '/' + bucket + '/' + urllib.parse.quote(key, safe='/')
    canonical_headers = f'host:{host}\nx-amz-content-sha256:{payload_hash}\nx-amz-date:{amzdate}\n'
    signed_headers = 'host;x-amz-content-sha256;x-amz-date'
    canonical_request = f'PUT\n{canonical_uri}\n\n{canonical_headers}\n{signed_headers}\n{payload_hash}'
    credential_scope = f'{datestamp}/{region}/s3/aws4_request'
    string_to_sign = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256\n{amzdate}\n{credential_scope}\n{hashlib.sha256(canonical_request.encode()).hexdigest()}'
    def _sign(k, m): return hmac.new(k, m.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    k_date = _sign(('AWS4' + secret_key).encode(), datestamp)
    k_region = _sign(k_date, region); k_service = _sign(k_region, 's3'); k_signing = _sign(k_service, 'aws4_request')
    signature = hmac.new(k_signing, string_to_sign.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    auth = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential={access_key}/{credential_scope}, SignedHeaders={signed_headers}, Signature={signature}'
    rq = urllib.request.Request(f'{endpoint}{canonical_uri}', data=data, method='PUT', headers={
        'Host': host, 'X-Amz-Date': amzdate, 'X-Amz-Content-SHA256': payload_hash,
        'Authorization': auth, 'Content-Type': content_type,
    })
    with urllib.request.urlopen(rq, timeout=180) as resp:
        return resp.status

def tts_call(payload, timeout=900):
    body = json.dumps(payload).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(OMNIVOICE_URL, data=body, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
        return r.read(), r.headers.get('X-Sample-Rate')

output = []
for it in _items:
    chunk = dict(it['json'])
    slug = chunk.get('slug', 'unknown')
    cid = int(chunk.get('chunk_id', 0))
    total = int(chunk.get('total_chunks', 0))
    bucket = chunk.get('audio_bucket', 'mottruyen-audio')
    payload = {'text': chunk.get('text', '')}
    if chunk.get('ref_audio'): payload['ref_audio'] = chunk['ref_audio']
    if chunk.get('ref_text'): payload['ref_text'] = chunk['ref_text']
    if chunk.get('voice_design'): payload['voice_design'] = chunk['voice_design']
    if chunk.get('seed') is not None: payload['seed'] = chunk['seed']
    try:
        wav_bytes, sr = tts_call(payload)
        key = f'{slug}/chunk_{cid:04d}.wav'
        s3_put(bucket, key, wav_bytes, 'audio/wav')
        chunk['audio_key'] = f'{bucket}/{key}'
        chunk['audio_size'] = len(wav_bytes)
        chunk['sample_rate'] = sr
    except Exception as e:
        chunk['audio_error'] = str(e)
    finally:
        chunk.pop('text', None)  # don't carry text through downstream
    output.append({'json': chunk})

return output

def s3_put(bucket, key, data, content_type='application/octet-stream'):

    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC)
    amzdate = now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'); datestamp = now.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    payload_hash = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    canonical_uri = '/' + bucket + '/' + urllib.parse.quote(key, safe='/')
    canonical_headers = f'host:{host}\nx-amz-content-sha256:{payload_hash}\nx-amz-date:{amzdate}\n'

    canonical_request = f'PUT\n{canonical_uri}\n\n{canonical_headers}\n{signed_headers}\n{payload_hash}'
    credential_scope = f'{datestamp}/{region}/s3/aws4_request'
    string_to_sign = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256\n{amzdate}\n{credential_scope}\n{hashlib.sha256(canonical_request.encode()).hexdigest()}'
    def _sign(k, m): return hmac.new(k, m.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    k_date = _sign(('AWS4' + secret_key).encode(), datestamp)
    k_region = _sign(k_date, region); k_service = _sign(k_region, 's3'); k_signing = _sign(k_service, 'aws4_request')
    signature = hmac.new(k_signing, string_to_sign.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    auth = f'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential={access_key}/{credential_scope}, SignedHeaders={signed_headers}, Signature={signature}'
    rq = urllib.request.Request(f'{endpoint}{canonical_uri}', data=data, method='PUT', headers={
        'Host': host, 'X-Amz-Date': amzdate, 'X-Amz-Content-SHA256': payload_hash,
        'Authorization': auth, 'Content-Type': content_type,
    })
    with urllib.request.urlopen(rq, timeout=120) as resp:
        return resp.status

slug = None
bucket = None
clips = []
errors = []
for it in _items:
    j = it['json']
    slug = j.get('slug') or slug
    bucket = j.get('audio_bucket') or bucket
    if j.get('audio_key'):
        clips.append({'chunk_id': j.get('chunk_id'), 'key': j['audio_key'], 'size': j.get('audio_size'), 'sr': j.get('sample_rate')})
    if j.get('audio_error'):
        errors.append({'chunk_id': j.get('chunk_id'), 'error': j['audio_error']})

if not clips or not slug:
    return [{'json': {'status': 'no_clips', 'errors': errors}}]

clips.sort(key=lambda x: int(x['chunk_id'] or 0))
concat_lines = [f"file '{c['key'].split('/')[-1]}'" for c in clips]
concat_txt = '\n'.join(concat_lines) + '\n'
bucket = bucket or 'mottruyen-audio'
s3_put(bucket, f'{slug}/concat.txt', concat_txt.encode(), 'text/plain')

manifest = {
    'slug': slug,
    'bucket': bucket,
    'chunk_count': len(clips),
    'error_count': len(errors),
    'clips': clips,
    'errors': errors,
    'concat_cmd_local': f'ffmpeg -f concat -safe 0 -i concat.txt -c copy {slug}.wav',
    'concat_cmd_mp3': f'ffmpeg -f concat -safe 0 -i concat.txt -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 128k {slug}.mp3',
}
s3_put(bucket, f'{slug}/manifest.json', json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode(), 'application/json')

return [{'json': manifest}]
